text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in us-midatlantic (edgepool-17). Auto-paging OnCall-Dana and SRE rotation. Severity: S2.
OnCall-Dana: acked. pulling logs now — creating thread for mitigation notes. @SRE-Alex you good to take lead if this needs cross-region steering? :phone:
SRE-Alex: I'm up. quick check: dashboards show 502/504 spike starting 6213141500, error rate ~18% on edge->ingress paths. latencies spiking to 3-6s.
Eng-Ben: seeing increased 503s from gateway LB to inference-gateway pods in us-midatlantic. Backend ML workers healthy per kube metrics. looks like egress/NAT failures and connection resets.
Support-Maya: customers flagged timeout errors from hosted API, some requests returning 504. initial CS triage: ~40 customers with errors in last 10m, majority PLG workloads hitting stream endpoints.
Infra-Charlie: checking NAT pool utilization — one of the edge NATs reported connection exhaustion and conntrack drops around 6213141450. we have partial pool degradation.
SRE-Alex: good catch. immediate mitigations: 1) shift traffic off edgepool-17 to us-east1 and eu-west1 via smart-routing rule OR 2) enable fallback routing to dedicated-backend tier. Which is faster?
OnCall-Dana: I can toggle smart-routing to prefer us-east1 for 20% of sticky sessions and 100% for new sessions. Doing a small reroute test now.
OnCall-Dana: /runbook reroute-edgepool — command executed (see logs below).
OnCall-Dana: ```
# temporary policy
smart-routing set-priority --region us-east1 --weight 60 --region eu-west1 --weight 40 --target edgepool-17=drain
```
Eng-Ben: started gradual 60/40 shift. telemetry shows error rate on us-midatlantic falling from 18% -> 9% within 30s for new sessions. existing sessions still hitting edgepool-17.
ML-Dev-Max: note: some long-running streaming sessions keep kv-cache open; draining might disrupt them. Recommend canary draining with connection TTL to allow streams to finish.
SRE-Alex: Agreed. set drain mode with 300s grace. OnCall-Dana can you configure drain TTL?
OnCall-Dana: set drain TTL=300s. Applied.
Infra-Charlie: scaling: spinning up extra NAT nodes as hot standbys in us-midatlantic, but provisioning is taking ~90s. alternative: move egress SNAT to the overflow pool in us-east1.
Support-Maya: crafting customer comms: "We are experiencing elevated timeouts in us-midatlantic, limited impact observed, mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30 minutes." anyone object?
SRE-Alex: send. include recommended temporary workaround: retry with linear backoff 500ms x3.
Support-Maya: sent.
Eng-Ben: digging into LB logs: many upstream 502s show ECONNRESET from edgeproxy to nat-gateway. sample log: ```
[6213141547] proxy_id=ep-17 upstream=nat-3 err=EPIPE read=0
```
SRE-Alex: ok that matches conntrack exhaustion. action: increase conntrack max and clear stale entries on nat-3. Charlie can you run conntrack flush on nat-3?
Infra-Charlie: preparing to run `conntrack -F` on nat-3, will do after confirming maintenance window with traffic shift.
OnCall-Dana: confirm safe to flush now — majority traffic routed off ep-17 for new sessions. clear in 20s.
Infra-Charlie: running flush now.
Infra-Charlie: flush complete. conntrack entries dropped from ~420k to 80k. kernel reports freed sockets.
Eng-Ben: immediate drop in 502s to ~4% for both new and some existing sessions. good.
ML-Dev-Max: monitoring streaming endpoints — no observed mid-stream disconnects beyond expected few.
SRE-Alex: next: we should temporarily increase connection timeout and add circuit-breaker to edgepool-17 to avoid spike re-amplification. Eng-Ben can you push config?
Eng-Ben: pushing circuit-breaker config (threshold=5 errors/10s, cooldown=60s) to ep-17 now.
Eng-Ben: config applied.
SRE-Alex: metrics look stable, latency trending down. set monitoring alert to auto-escalate if error >5% for 5m.
IncidentBot: note added to incident timeline: mitigation steps (traffic shift, conntrack flush, circuit-breaker) at 6213141625.
OnCall-Dana: I'm going to handoff to SRE-Alex for postmortem and RCA. SRE-Alex, please own the follow-up and runbook updates. I'll stay on standby for pages.
SRE-Alex: taking ownership. summary for postmortem: root cause likely NAT conntrack exhaustion on nat-3 causing upstream resets; contributing factor: insufficient fallback weighting and no circuit-breaker on edgepool. Action items: [ ] update conntrack defaults and auto-scale NATs, [ ] add circuit-breakers to edgepools by default, [ ] improve smart-routing fallback thresholds, [ ] run chaos test for conntrack saturation.
Support-Maya: creating support ticket bundle with affected customers list + suggested mitigation notes. Ticket ID: CS-89412.
Infra-Charlie: will schedule kernel tunables patch and autoscale rule for nat nodes.
ML-Dev-Max: will add guidance to streaming-runbook about draining long-lived kv sessions.
SRE-Alex: good. timeline: incident declared 6213141500, mitigations in place and stable by 6213141660. Next update: 30m post-incident with RCA draft.
Support-Maya: will send customer follow-up in 30m.
OnCall-Dana: closing this response thread; if anything regresses ping me immediate. great job everyone. :thumbsup:
SRE-Alex: thanks team. IncidentBot: incident resolved (mitigated) — switching to post-incident tracking.
